table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	saleorderheader.saleordercode,   
	saleorderheader.flatdisc,   
	saleorderheader.misccharges,   
	saleorderheader.discperc,

	misccharges1=saleorderheader.misccharges1,   
	misccharges2=saleorderheader.misccharges2,   
	misccharges3=saleorderheader.misccharges3,   
	misccharges4=saleorderheader.misccharges4,   
	misccharges5=saleorderheader.misccharges5,   
	FBRPOSFee = saleorderheader.FBRPOSFee,
	AdvanceTaxAmt = saleorderheader.AdvanceTaxAmt,

	Icode = 0, 
	itemtotalval=space(30),
	Stock = 0.0000,
	TotalStock = 0.0000,
	Total = 0.00,
	purdiscperc = 0.00,
	InvGSTPerc1= saleorderheader.Invgstperc1,
	avgprice=0.000,
	rpp=0.00,
	purprice=0.00,
	BonusRatio=SPACE(20),
	LatestNetRate=0.00,
	retailprice=0.00
FROM 
	saleorderheader  
WHERE 
	saleorderheader.saleordercode = :ar_invcode
